[[application-profile-matrix]]
=== Application profile evidence

All 53 upstream executables remain in every profile. Each cell gives the compile/run result independently. P = measured pass, F = measured failure, B = blocked, U = unavailable, N = no measured result.

A passing counterpart preserves the measured application operations. It does not establish unchanged source, scheduling, DNS, TLS policy or failure semantics. Native oracle comparison covers payloads/status/modes, excluding fixture addresses and elapsed time. Local native measurements use macOS ARM64; other operating systems require their CI runs. Raw results and commands are retained by the drivers.

|===

==== Adaptations and limits

* WASIp3 uses a fixture resolver posting the known local endpoint. DNS worker threads remain unverified. Worker/system executors use an explicit event loop.
* Host HTTP preserves file handlers or request/body operations. Host listeners, framing and TLS are distinct from guest sockets. Six HTTPS client counterparts run through a configured Wasmtime host with an isolated CA, rejecting unknown issuers and trusted certificates for the wrong hostname. The documentation client additionally measures host-owned mutual TLS and missing-identity rejection. The documentation server measures a host mutual-TLS frontend.
* The host crawler retains upstream report aggregation and two asynchronous workers over bounded authority/path inputs. Its fixture uses two peers, six paths, four response statuses, and a truncated-response failure followed by continued work. Host HTTP combines transport phases: failures count as Read; separate DNS/connect/write/timer phase counts are unmeasured.
* Supplied streams replace Unix-domain addressing with caller-provided stdio. P2 WebSocket counterparts retain asynchronous partial operations through Asio pollables; the other supplied counterparts use synchronous partial operations.
* Browser fetch/WebSocket own DNS, framing and TLS. Guest CA lists, protocol pinning and handshake User-Agent are removed explicitly. HTTPS fixtures install an ephemeral CA in an isolated Chrome profile. A fresh untrusted profile rejects the certificate; the trusted profile rejects its incorrect IP hostname. No certificate-error bypass or system trust-store modification is used.
* Exception-off counterparts retain error-code paths and successful operations; formerly throwing paths report failure and abort. Stackful Context remains blocked.
* Asio P2 provides sockets and guest TLS, but the Beast guest-socket and guest-TLS application corpus still needs P2 integration and validation. Browser listeners and WASI Unix-domain socket addressing remain unavailable. WASIp3 cooperative EH-on lacks the toolchain exception runtime.

==== Reproduction

[source,bash]
----
python3 libs/beast/test/applications/inventory.py --check
python3 libs/beast/example/applications/tools/prepare.py --clang-format clang-format
b2 libs/beast/test/applications//applications
b2 toolset=clang-wasip3 libs/beast/test/applications/wasip3//applications-p3
b2 toolset=emscripten libs/beast/test/applications/browser//applications-browser
b2 toolset=clang-wasip2 libs/beast/test/applications/host//applications-host
b2 toolset=clang-wasip2 libs/beast/test/applications/host-clients//applications-host-clients
cargo build --locked --manifest-path libs/beast/test/applications/host-tls/Cargo.toml --target-dir .local/host-tls
export PATH="$PWD/.local/host-tls/debug:$PATH"
b2 toolset=clang-wasip2 libs/beast/test/applications/host-tls//applications-host-tls
b2 libs/beast/test/applications/noexcept//applications-noexcept
b2 toolset=clang-wasip3 libs/beast/test/applications/noexcept//applications-single-noexcept
b2 toolset=emscripten libs/beast/test/applications/browser-noexcept//applications-browser
b2 toolset=clang-wasip3 libs/beast/test/applications/streams//applications-streams
b2 toolset=clang-wasip3 libs/beast/test/applications/streams//applications-websocket-streams
b2 libs/beast/test/applications/chat//applications-chat
----

Configure pinned toolchains with the standard B2 user configuration. Clear CPATH/C_INCLUDE_PATH/CPLUS_INCLUDE_PATH. Runtime peers bind loopback ports, wait for readiness, enforce deadlines, and reap every process.
